decision: Keep direct source signed scalar stress supervision; do not add a constitutive scalar equality loss derived from predicted displacement until the exporter formula/sign/recovery convention is established.

scope.local_reads: CSV header only and SolverDeck output-request header only; existing source notes used for prior provenance

confirmed.source_storage: One scalar per FEM node for each static load; source CSV uses no tensor/principal component designation
confirmed.source_signed_policy: Previously verified source values allow negative numbers; preserve existing raw signed targets, without abs or relabeling
confirmed.author_description: The original dataset paper explicitly calls Field Data signed von Mises stress and says the sign distinguishes tensile/compressive states. This describes intended semantics; it does not specify the export formula.

local_evidence.conclusion: CSV names alone do not identify a tensor component, principal stress, invariant formula, or sign rule.
Generic STRESS/GPSTRESS ALL requests permit multiple stress results; they do not identify which scalar was selected by the H3D-to-CSV exporter, or its averaging/recovery/sign settings.
Already distinguishes the paper terminology from the source stress(MPa) field and preserves signed raw targets; no exact exporter formula is documented here.

primary_evidence.title: DeepJEB original paper, arXiv 2406.09047v2
locations: Section 3.3 FEA Simulation Results, Figure 6 and adjacent paragraph
primary_evidence.short_quote: We also provide signed von Mises stress data
primary_evidence.paraphrase: The authors identify the nodal stress as signed von Mises and associate its sign with tension/compression. The checked text provides no explicit sign function, exporter selector, or nodal recovery/averaging formula.
primary_evidence.supports: Author-intended scalar family; not a proof of an exact per-file constitutive scalar mapping.

primary_evidence.supports: Release provenance, not constitutive stress semantics.

unknown.exact_exporter_result_component: Unknown; no exporter component selector/code was located in the two checked primary pages or allowed local metadata.
unknown.scalar_formula_and_sign_function: Unknown. Do not assume sign(trace(sigma)), sign(max principal), or sign(abs-dominant principal).
unknown.principal_stress_or_cartesian_component: No evidence identifies the actual scalar as a specific principal index or tensor component. The author-described intent is signed von Mises, pending exact exporter verification.
unknown.nodal_recovery: Unknown tensor averaging/extrapolation location and whether scalar invariant is computed before/after averaging.
unknown.tensor_components: Not present in this CSV header; generic solver requests do not make tensor components available in the stored prepared target.
unknown.numerical_matching_to_predicted_u: Not tested; no field labels or predictions were accessed.

future_requirements: Obtain the original H3D-to-CSV export selector/code or an author definition of the exact scalar and sign convention.
Establish nodal tensor recovery/averaging and unit conventions before comparing a constitutive tensor derived from u with the stored scalar.
Retain the known linear isotropic MAT1 assumptions for C:epsilon only as tensor-level model assumptions; they do not resolve the missing scalar export rule.
Any eventual calibration/verification must use training data only and preserve the current dia/final-test holdout policy.
limitations: The signed-von-Mises wording is confirmed in the paper, but exact agreement between a chosen reconstruction formula and the released scalar is not established.
No new unsigned-von-Mises target, principal target, abs transform, or tensor reconstruction was created.
This bounded source review stops with the exact exporter/sign/recovery convention unknown; it is not an exhaustive search of unpublished author tooling.
